title: Reversa Pricing Product
description: Breakeven per product sales model (perpetual license, rental, subscription, app store) generated by the reversa-pricing-product agent.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the creation or last regeneration.

research_ref.description: Path of research/comparables.json when the price ladder was researched; null when typed.

monthly_recurring_cost.description: Monthly cost to keep the software running, in the profile currency.

monthly_target_income.description: Desired monthly income with the product.

development_cost_to_recover.description: Development investment to recover. 0 when not considered.

recovery_horizon_months.description: Months to recover the investment and evaluate the one-off sale.

tax_factor.description: Approximate tax reserve, copied from profile.tax_factor.

total_monthly_cost.description: monthly_recurring_cost + development_cost_to_recover / recovery_horizon_months, without rounding. Used in the recurring models.

horizon_cost.description: monthly_recurring_cost * recovery_horizon_months + development_cost_to_recover, without rounding. Used in the one-off sale.

price_ladders.description: One price ladder per unit present among the calculated models. monthly = price per month (subscription, monthly rental, store with subscription); yearly = price per year (yearly rental); license = price per license (perpetual license, store with one-off sale).

ladder_unit.description: Key of inputs.price_ladders used by this model: monthly (period_months = 1), yearly (period_months = 12) or license (one-off sale).

period_months.description: 1 = monthly, 12 = yearly; null in the one-off sale.

store.description: Store key (google_play, app_store, microsoft_store, steam, other) when channel = store; null on the direct channel.

commission_percent.description: Store commission in percent. 0 on the direct channel.

commission_source.description: Source of the commission: line of store-commissions.md with date, research path or 'informed by the user'. null on the direct channel.

price.description: Ladder price, per period (recurring) or per license (one-off sale).

equivalent_monthly_price.description: price / period_months in the recurring models; null in the one-off sale.

net.description: Net per payer/month (recurring) or per license (one-off sale), after commission and tax reserve, 2 decimals.

payers_to_cover_cost.description: Recurring: active payers per month to cover the total monthly cost. null in the one-off sale.

payers_to_goal.description: Recurring: active payers per month to cover cost plus goal. null in the one-off sale.

units_to_cover_cost.description: One-off sale: licenses in the horizon to cover the cost. null in the recurring models.

units_to_goal.description: One-off sale: licenses in the horizon to cover cost plus goal. null in the recurring models.

units_per_month_to_goal.description: One-off sale: units_to_goal / recovery_horizon_months, rounded up. null in the recurring models.

available.description: false when the net does not cover commission and tax.

reason.description: Reason when available = false; null otherwise.

reading_en.description: One-sentence reading of the model, in plain language.

summary_en.description: Summary per model: lowest requirement (highest price) and highest requirement (lowest price).

guidance_en.description: Choice guidance and limits of the calculator.

prices.description: Prices in ascending order, in the unit of the key.

origin.description: typed = the user listed the prices; researched = built from research/comparables.json.
